Each new test directory carries an empty __init__.py.

A01 PROPOSED allowances for this workstream (caps, not forecasts; the operator accepts them by authorizing the macro): elapsed wall time 120 min from dispatch; subagent tokens 1,500,000; tool uses 300; child attempts: 1 attempt + 1 retry; team-lead review rounds: 1 diff re-read + at most 1 correction round. Active (model-working) time is not separately recordable by the harness: UNKNOWN; elapsed is the enforceable bound.

A02 The team lead reads the recordable counters from the child's completion notice (duration_ms, subagent_tokens, tool_uses) and records them with the return. A retry is allowed only after a failed validation with a named cause and only once; a second failure, any exceeded cap or any advisor call ends the workstream.

A03 When a cap is hit: stop the workstream, start no further attempt, preserve the uncommitted diff untouched, and return NEEDS_SUPERVISOR with the counters and the evidence. No model upgrade, provider change or extra attempt without a new operator ruling.

B01 Writes means every mutating MCP tool in mcp_http.py and every mutating REST route in dope_memory_main.py (W00 Q6 lists them). A write without workspace_id or instance_id is rejected with a clear error; neither is filled from process env any more.

B02 Binding check (design 5.1): the container is bound to one workspace by its env at start; a write whose workspace_id does not match the binding is rejected. Reads keep working for the bound workspace.

B03 Auth middleware: mode from one env setting (name per W00 or chosen here and documented): off (today's behaviour), log (accept; store the verified principal or `unverified`; count unverified calls), enforce (reject unverified with 401). Token check: SHA-256 of the bearer token compared in constant time (hmac.compare_digest) with the hashes in a read-only file whose path comes from env; never log the header or token.

B04 Principal column: nullable with default `unverified` (design 5.9) through the existing migration path; the migration has a rollback step (drop the column). Running it against a real database is an operator step (C10).
B05 Health: GET /health (or the existing health route) reports the auth mode and that identity-required writes are on, as fields the W06 gate can read; name them in the return.

B06 compose.yml: only the dope-memory service's environment and a read-only mount of the host hash directory (~/.config/dopemux/auth/, design 5.2); default mode `log`. No port, image or other service changes.

B07 Tests: missing ids rejected (MCP and REST), workspace mismatch rejected, each mode (off/log/enforce) with valid, invalid and missing tokens, principal stored, constant-time compare used, header never logged, migration up and down on a temp SQLite file.
